{{Top}}
{{Quote|Sithspit! I have to get out of here!|[[Jaden Korr]] during the [[Mission to Zonju V]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>}}
'''"Sithspit"''' was one of the most common curse words used throughout the era of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], through the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and into the time of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. Originating on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], it expressed outrage, surprise, pain, frustration, or simply displeasure.

Although it was a nonsense word, the inclusion of '[[Sith/Legends|Sith]]' was probably a jab toward the age-old enemies of the Republic and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]'', when Kyle said "Sithspit! I need to get him to a bacta tank!", there is a subtitle error. The subtitles say "Sith spit! I need to get him to a bacta tank!", incorrectly spacing the word.
